name: Reactive 45° Cut from a Sprint
setup: Sprint 10 metres to the cone, then cut. Cones set for the cut.
cues: Go on a point or a call from a partner, not on your own count.
Plant outside the hips and push the floor away on the angle to the next cone.
Push the floor away from the way you want to go.

faults.fault: Knee caving in on the plant
faults.fix: Plant with the knee out over the laces and push the floor away.
Lower the hips before the plant, like ducking under a bar.

cautions: Plant only as hard as you can stop: build to full speed over a few sets.
